summary: This short Informational document specifies an Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation (ALPN) identifier for CoAP services secured with DTLS. With an ID registered, both ends can agree during the handshake that they will speak CoAP.

eli5.summary: Two people meeting in a secret room first agree which language they will speak. This registers the name tag for the CoAP language.

questions: alpn id for coap over dtls
how to negotiate coap with alpn
